prompts.title: Confirm this job’s setting
prompts.wording: Record the residential work type, scope, circuit identifiers and any unresolved workplace or code applicability question.
prompts.applicability: Before selecting requirements for this job.
prompts.rationale: Separate installation rules from workplace rules.
prompts.limits: No industrial, utility or live-work assessment.
prompts.reviewQuestions: Confirm wording, current source mapping, setting/exemption boundaries and omissions within your qualification scope. No industrial, utility or live-work assessment.

prompts.title: Record people and credential evidence
prompts.wording: Record the contractor business and LEC reference, designated master electrician and each relevant individual qualification reference. Record any actual external check separately.
prompts.applicability: Contractor jobs and participating personnel; consider specific statutory exemptions.
prompts.rationale: An app administrator is not a professional credential.
prompts.limits: No live registry verification; a user report of a check is not independent TradeSafe validation.
prompts.reviewQuestions: Confirm wording, current source mapping, setting/exemption boundaries and omissions within your qualification scope. No live registry verification; a user report of a check is not independent TradeSafe validation.

prompts.title: Keep ESA status separate
prompts.wording: Record a notification reference or an unresolved applicability question with its proposed basis and source. Record inspection requests, outcomes and retained evidence separately.
prompts.applicability: Before relying on notification or acceptance status.
prompts.rationale: Internal completion does not issue an ESA certificate.
prompts.limits: No automated exemption, inspection or acceptance decision.
prompts.reviewQuestions: Confirm wording, current source mapping, setting/exemption boundaries and omissions within your qualification scope. No automated exemption, inspection or acceptance decision.

prompts.title: Record the qualified assessment and procedures
prompts.wording: Reference the responsible personnel’s hazard assessment, applicable employer procedure version and verification record. Put today’s hazards and controls in the daily brief; record new concerns at any time.
prompts.applicability: Only after establishing the actual workplace and task context.
prompts.rationale: Keep assessment, implemented controls and review distinct.
prompts.limits: No live-work instructions, PPE selection, voltage inference or energization authorization.
prompts.reviewQuestions: Confirm wording, current source mapping, setting/exemption boundaries and omissions within your qualification scope. No live-work instructions, PPE selection, voltage inference or energization authorization.

prompts.title: Show what remains unresolved
prompts.wording: Identify missing documentation, link deficiencies to Actions, and retain the original finding and later correction separately.
prompts.rationale: Keeps documentation, internal review, ESA status and attached evidence independent.
prompts.limits: A closed action or acknowledgement is not legal approval.
prompts.reviewQuestions: Confirm wording, current source mapping, setting/exemption boundaries and omissions within your qualification scope. A closed action or acknowledgement is not legal approval.
